entities.summary: Israel Shamir, also known by the names Robert David, Vassili Krasevsky, Jöran Jermas and Adam Ermash, is a Swedish writer and journalist, known for his ties to WikiLeaks and for promoting antisemitism and Holocaust denial. His son Johannes Wahlström is a spokesperson for WikiLeaks in Sweden. Israel Shamir was a journalists & chroniclers from Novosibirsk (b. 1947-06-11, Novosibirsk). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
